correction: MS-112 is hypothesis-generating only. Its seven rows were correlated deployment views, not seven independent tasks; the cache-contract rows lacked HEAD_ADAPT and had one seed; and the calculator silently intersected available actions. The reported 0.085 is therefore a diagnostic upper bound over CACHED_HEAD versus RAW_FINETUNE, not a G0 pass or a selector result.
paper_question: Given an already materialized Earth representation, its input/release contract, a target deployment, a label budget, and measured resource limits, should an operator reuse the current head, adapt a head, use a raw model, re-embed, or request more evidence?

novelty_boundary.claimed: pre-action lifecycle allocation for materialized Earth-observation representation caches, evaluated by held-out action regret and real encoder/raw-I/O/storage cost
not_claimed: backward-compatible embeddings as a new problem
independence of folds, support draws, or cache variants from the same task
novelty_boundary.hardcoded_family_rule_role: development baseline only; a cache-family identity or cache-worthiness lookup table is forbidden for leave-one-family-out promotion

allowed_features: measured cold-encode, warm-read, raw-I/O and storage costs
support-only class balance, LogME/Task2Vec and gradient/loss summaries

decision_unit: dataset_task x held_out_target_group x support_draw x K x cache_contract x cost_budget
nested_not_independent: random versus stratified draws from one target group

matrix_contract.rule: Every promoted submatrix must be rectangular: every episode has every required action with the preregistered seed count. A frozen budget may make a measured action ineligible after this audit; an unmeasured action may not be treated as ineligible.
matrix_contract.calculator: code/geobench_action_headroom.py with required_actions and required_seed_count declared

S_support.purpose: Does support composition change reuse versus head adaptation under one fixed, valuable cache?

F_cache_family.purpose: Does the value of a cache and the winning lifecycle action transfer to an unseen representation family?
F_cache_family.note: Clay may be added only with its resolution/input contract frozen before outcomes. A separate Z0 matrix uses CACHED_HEAD, RAW_FINETUNE and REEMBED because HEAD_ADAPT is undefined without labels. REEMBED is otherwise evaluated in a separate cost/lifecycle matrix unless the same encoder target is defined for every cell.

R_release.purpose: Handle a head/cache release mismatch without conflating it with task or cache-family selection.
R_release.fixed: same task, raw cube and target release
R_release.role: engineering and lifecycle appendix unless held-out releases and downstream utility produce a nontrivial decision boundary

datasets.korea: External shared-cache and amortization case. It cannot substitute for held-out public task/family validation.

anchors.rule: Declare per-task lower and upper reference scores before reading action outcomes; never min-max over evaluated actions.
anchors.lower: task-valid null or fixed supervised floor
anchors.upper: fixed full-label strong reference measured with the same split/metric
anchors.out_of_range: retain values below 0 or above 1 after normalization; do not clip

costs.forbidden: rounded or inferred costs in confirmatory G0/G1 claims

selector_baselines: best static policy learned on development tasks
cache-family lookup rule as an explicitly non-generalizing baseline
support-only LogME or Task2Vec in K tracks
oracle using query outcomes for evaluation only

outer_evaluation.primary: normalized regret to the best eligible measured action
secondary: harmful-action rate versus best safe static policy
outer_evaluation.uncertainty: task/family grouped interval; never treat rows or folds as i.i.d.

promotion_gates.G0_matrix: All promoted cells pass the rectangular action/seed audit.
promotion_gates.G0_heterogeneity: At least two independent held-out task groups have different robust best actions; cache variants or support draws from one task do not satisfy this alone.
promotion_gates.G0_value: Oracle headroom over best static is at least 0.02 with fixed anchors and measured costs.
promotion_gates.G1_selector: At least 30% lower mean regret than best static with a task-grouped interval excluding zero.
promotion_gates.G2_external: Direction repeats on at least two held-out public tasks and one held-out encoder family.
promotion_gates.G3_cost: At score within 0.01, at least 25% lower measured encoder plus raw-I/O cost than always recompute.
promotion_gates.G4_korea: Korea shared-cache case passes data eligibility and reports all three tasks plus exact amortization without being counted as three independent datasets.

stop_rules: If G0_matrix fails, do not report G0 headroom.
If task-level action heterogeneity fails externally, do not train a learned selector.
If the contract-only rule does not beat best static on held-out tasks, retain it as a baseline and publish cache-value characterization only.
Do not add MoE, VLM, RL, or post-training complexity to rescue a failed decision boundary.
